study: Matched-emission multidimensional information test, retrospective eSDIva RF
phase_error: For phase-error arm add angle phase drift of 0, +0.12, -0.12 radians over 80 frames and static receive-subaperture phase from -0.12 to +0.12 radians. Apply identically to blood, tissue, and noise. Prior calibration stays clean.
comparability: Every main method uses the same 240 emissions across 80 cycles; the single-image baseline coherently compounds the three angles, while the tensor methods preserve them. No 240-pulse single-transmit-angle or five-angle bank was acquired. The prior 16 calibration cycles for STAP are extra information.
selection: No setting selected using evaluation seed 3919; rank 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 tissue-truth projectors are explicit diagnostic bounds within their fixed rays. The broader rank sweep was declared after a seen 3907 pilot and before the 3919 method scores. Paper-factorization cutoff rules are predeclared study adaptations.
